name: Tavros Nitram
source:
Tavros Nitram, also known by his Trollian handle adiosToreador, is one of the trolls. 

He is too sensitive to be a decent troll (in the sense of one who provokes others). He sucks at trolling and usually ends up getting trolled himself. He seems innocently ignorant of his own shortcomings as a troll, and of mockery from others. He copes with the negativity he faces from the other trolls by personifying his self-esteem, which he has named Rufio. He also has the ability to commune with wildlife.

His associated zodiac sign is Taurus. He is a bronze blood, which is the second lowest caste on the trolls' hemospectrum.

[From [url=https://mspaintadventures.fandom.com/wiki/Tavros_Nitram]MSPA Wiki[/url]]
